content.question: Which statement about TF-IDF is correct?
options: TF-IDF assigns high weights to terms that appear frequently in a document but rarely in the rest of the corpus.
TF-IDF assigns high weights to terms that appear frequently across all documents in the corpus.
TF-IDF ignores how often a term appears in a given document and only counts document frequency.
TF-IDF is computed as df(t) divided by tf(t, d).
content.answer: TF-IDF assigns high weights to terms that appear frequently in a document but rarely in the rest of the corpus.
